cases.name: Karlyn Serane Ramirez
cases.about: She was a U.S. Army Pfc.
cases.narrative: On 8/25/2015, police found her dead on the floor of her master bedroom with her 4-month-old baby girl cradled in her arms after a maintenance man at her housing complex reported he found her back door open. Her husband Maliek had shot her 3 times in the chest at close range, left their infant in her arms, and pulled down her pants and underwear to stage a sexual assault.
